verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS calendar, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no telemetry, usage-tracking or data-collection opt-out for Google Calendar. The only privacy-related items are community complaints about data harvesting and server-side email scanning, which describe no opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
